_comment: Local youth sports registration windows (Penn Manor Youth Baseball/Softball, Penn Manor Soccer Club, etc.). Maintained by hand / via Cowork (or regenerated from the Event Candidates sheet by scripts/sync-candidates.js — if that sync is live for Youth Sports, edit the SHEET, not this file). Two consumers: (1) scrape.js creates an event dated on each deadline that auto-hides once the deadline passes; (2) the homepage 'Upcoming Signups' section surfaces each entry to TOWNIES starting about a month before its deadline. Marauders/students don't see the signups section (it's local family content).
_format: Each entry: org (required, e.g. 'Penn Manor Youth Baseball' — used as the event location and the Upcoming Signups sub-line), sport (optional, e.g. 'Baseball & Softball'), deadline (required UNLESS closesTBA is set, ISO 8601 with Eastern offset — the registration CLOSE date/time), closesTBA (optional bool — set true for an OPEN-ENDED registration that is live but has no announced close date; such an entry has NO deadline, creates NO calendar event, and is shown reminder-only in Upcoming Signups as 'Open now / closes TBA' until its row is removed), registerLink (required, URL to sign up), title (optional — the human display title for the event card/timeline, e.g. 'Junior Comets Football & Cheerleading'; if omitted scrape.js falls back to org + sport), opens (optional ISO), season (optional, e.g. 'Spring 2026'), ageRange (optional, e.g. 'Ages 5-14'), note (optional, short extra detail — do NOT repeat 'Registration closes <date>'; scrape.js appends that line automatically), status ('active' | 'draft' — only 'active' is used). Entries auto-skip once their deadline passes.

registrations.title: Penn Manor Youth Baseball & Softball - Spring 2027 Registration
registrations.note: Spring 2027 registration for in-house tee ball (ages 4-5), Minors and Majors, plus 8U-14U baseball and softball league teams. Create or log in to an account on the site to register; fees do not include uniforms. Not affiliated with Penn Manor School District.
